name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new capability or a usability improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: []

---

## Problem to solve
Explain the user problem.

## Proposed behavior
Describe the expected UI and workflow.

## Safety impact
Would this change enumerate disks, run elevated commands, write test data, remove partitions or format volumes?

## Platform and context
Windows version, relevant UI tab, alternative workflows considered.

## Acceptance criteria
What observable behavior would demonstrate that the feature works? Do not claim implementation or testing that has not happened.
